# Abdelhmeed Elshorbagy

> Abdelhmeed Elshorbagy (full name Abdelhmeed Mohsen Elshorbagy; also written Abdelhameed Elshorbagy or Abdelhmeed El Shorbagy) is an IT help desk technician at Amwag Travel in Minya, Egypt, the founder of the fragrance brand DÖSE, and a Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence student at Minya National University. Official website: https://www.abdelhmeed.com/

## Facts

- Current role: IT Help Desk at Amwag Travel, Minya, Egypt (Feb 2025 – present), on a three-person IT team; first point of contact for staff technical issues and booking-system operations.
- Earlier at Amwag Travel: Customer Service Representative (Aug 2024 – Feb 2025); Ticketing Agent (Jun 2023 – Aug 2023).
- Built Amwag Attendance, Amwag Travel's bilingual (Arabic/English) employee attendance platform, end to end (Next.js, TypeScript, MySQL/MariaDB).
- Founder of DÖSE (https://doseeg.com), an Egyptian niche fragrance brand, since Oct 2025; built its Shopify store.
- Founded abameda store, an online store for digital gaming products serving Egypt and the GCC (Jun 2021 – Aug 2023, closed).
- Education: B.Sc. Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence, Minya National University, 2024 – 2028 (expected).
- Certification: Technical Support Fundamentals, Google (2024).
- Languages: Arabic (native), English.
